item.title: ...But the Sun was eclipsed by the Moon
item.description:
Last week there was an eclipse which could be seen in large parts of europe.;/p>

I wrote a small blog post on my experience with the eclipse and how i built a projector out of a pringles can so that i could actually see the eclipse last minute !;/p>

- Miles ^= || =^

item.title: Oh Hi Mark
item.description:
The Room page is finally live ! There is still a lot of work to be done, though !

First of, only the game and vinyl collection pages are available at the moment. Also, almost all games and vinyls listed in the collection are still missing their seperate entries.

And there are also still a bunch of games missing from the collection in general ^^'

Planing on adding these periodically !

Thank you for the patience ! This took way too long ^^' - Miles ^= || =^
